body: did you know: the week reputation dropped, it outsold every other album on the billboard 200 combined. 1.216 million in pure sales -- the #2 album that week did 66,000. no streaming, no interviews, a wiped social feed. she went quiet and they showed up anyway.
why: X-native (text-only) version of the reputation chart did-you-know, keeping X active. Same sourced facts as the IG sibling, trimmed to the sharpest ones: outsold the rest of the Billboard 200 combined, 1.216M pure sales vs the #2 album's 66,000, and the deliberate quiet rollout. Every claim traces to the Vault reputation 'sells more than the rest of the chart combined' item (Billboard/Refinery29/Forbes). Chart lore only, outside every blocklist topic.
